17 Cabo San Lucas hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Cabo San Lucas hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Cabo San Lucas hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Traveluro at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Evendo at 1, Luxury Escapes at 1 and Reserving at 1. These are the Cabo San Lucas rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 9 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Super.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Evendo at 1 and Luxury Escapes at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 8, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Cabo San Lucas hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($31 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 17% at Casa Dorada Resort & Spa to 26% at Hotel Casa Palo Verde. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
